system.description:
• Effect: The country you chose for Nature Lore at 1st level blesses you wherever you are (if you swap that country later, your Blessing changes after a season in the new one).
  • It gives one benefit that is always on and one you may use once per encounter.
  • Where a use names "a creature your spell damages", it is one creature of your choice that your spell of 1st level or higher damages, and it saves against your spell DC.
  • Forest: +1 AC. Once per encounter, when you cast a spell, one creature within 60ft makes a Reflex save or is Restrained by roots until the end of its next turn.
  • Hills and mountains: you can't be knocked Prone or pushed against your will while you stand on the ground. Once per encounter, a creature your spell damages makes a Fortitude save or falls Prone.
  • Marsh: Advantage on saves against poison and disease, and you ignore the Poisoned condition from any creature of lower Level than yours. Once per encounter, a creature your spell damages makes a Fortitude save or is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.
  • Plains: +10ft speed. Once per encounter, right after you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, move up to 30ft; this movement provokes no Attacks of Opportunity.
  • Coast: you swim at your speed and breathe water. Once per encounter, a creature your spell damages makes a Fortitude save or is pushed 15ft and knocked Prone.
  • Desert: Resistance 5 to fire (Resistance 10 if Elemental Mastery also gives you Resistance to fire, until it makes you immune). Once per encounter, a creature your spell damages makes a Reflex save or is Blinded by sand until the end of its next turn.
  • Frozen north: Resistance 5 to cold (Resistance 10 if Elemental Mastery also gives you Resistance to cold, until it makes you immune). Once per encounter, a creature your spell damages makes a Fortitude save or has its speed halved and can't act out of turn until the end of its next turn.
  • Underdark: darkvision 60ft (or 60ft more). Once per encounter, right after you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, you may Hide as part of the same action, even in plain sight, if you are in dim light or darkness.
